sources.title: MedScribe AI
sources.snippet: MedScribe AI goes beyond simple transcription, intelligently processing visit transcripts to generate concise, structured summaries. This ensures that critical information, follow-ups, and clinical tasks are automatically identified and presented, saving valuable time for healthcare professionals.

sources.title: MedScribe A.I.
sources.snippet: The AI Medical Scribe Built for Clinicians Speak your notes. MedScribe AI generates complete, compliant clinical documentation in seconds — so you can spend more time healing, less time charting.

sources.snippet: MedScribe AI A healthcare AI platform I built to explore how clinical documentation systems work in Norwegian healthcare. It combines speech-to-text, structured note generation, and agentic workflows into a single deployable service, with a focus on privacy-first local processing.
